div.head: Grið 1
div.ab: Godes grið is ealra griða selast to geearnianne 7 geornost to healdanne 7 þær nehst þæs cynges.
Godes grið is ealra griða selast to geearnianne and geornost to healdanne and þær nehst þæs cynges.
Of all forms of sanctuary, the sanctuary of God is the best to deserve and the most diligently to be held, and next to that, the king’s.
Gottes Friedensschutz ist unter allen Sonderfrieden am vorzüglichsten zu verdienen und am eifrigsten zu halten; und demnächst [der] des Königs.
God's peace-protection is, of all special peaces, the most excellent to earn and the most zealously to be kept; and next to it [that] of the king.
